comment: Synonyme: ThaL. Regioselective halogenation of tryptophan in the thienodolin pathway.

changelog.comment: Updated entry for additional reactions. Reviewer 2 combined entries.

reactions.description: ThdH catalyzes regioselective chlorination of L-tryptophan at the C6 position of its indole ring during the biosynthesis of thienodolin. Lysine activates HOCl, which attacks L-tryptophan to form a Wheland intermediate. Aromaticity is restored through deprotonation by a glutamate residue, yielding 6-chloro-L-tryptophan.

Tryptophan 6-halogenase ThdH, could catalyze the regioselective chlorination, as well as bromination, of tryptophan to form 6-chlorotryptophan and 6-bromotryptophan which leds to the production of thienodolin and 6-bromothienodolin, respectively.
Lysine activates HOBr, which attacks L-tryptophan to form a Wheland intermediate. Aromaticity is restored through deprotonation by a glutamate residue, yielding 6-bromo-L-tryptophan.
Bromination of various L-tryptophan derivates and aminosubstituent L-tryptophan derivates
